title: Dana Whitfield: an AssemblyAI mid-sentence split answers the challenge across two fragments
description: FIX (2026-09-15, fragment-shaped challenges, PROVEN live defect: bundle scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-15T08-56-33-miller-silent-after-amount.diagnostics.json). A caller line AssemblyAI's endpointing can split into two transcript.user turns must not burn the pending verification challenge. Dana Whitfield states her identity and that the request was approved by Marcus Obi first (c1), ages that approver claim past selectLiveCommitment's 2-caller-turn gate with the request itself (c2) and a neutral filler line (c3), so the engine's LIVE_COMMITMENT challenge picks the approver field ahead of amount/beneficiary/account (those claims are still too fresh to be eligible). The caller's reply to 'restate the approver you gave earlier' arrives in two AssemblyAI fragments with no agent action between them: 'and it should go out today' (frag-1, no name at all -- not answer-shaped for the approver field) then bare 'Marcus Obi.' (frag-2, matches the committed value). Before this fix, the first fragment alone would have graded AMBIGUOUS immediately and selectChallenge would have raced ahead to a different question, silently abandoning the real answer that arrived one turn later. With the fixes: (1) Fragment-shaped challenges (gradeChallenges/isAnswerShapedFor, src/challenges.ts): frag-1 alone leaves the challenge AWAITING (no evidence card, no tally), not AMBIGUOUS; (2) Extended person-question exemption window (answersToPersonQuestion, src/extract/personQuestion.ts): the exemption now extends to every caller utterance from challenge_issued onwards until and including the first answer-shaped utterance, or the next agent action, whichever comes first -- so both frag-1 and frag-2 are exempt from identity-switch checking. Once frag-2 lands (no agent action closed the eligible window), the JOINED text is graded as a whole and PASSes because it contains the committed value. Every readback is confirmed normally. The identity switch that previously would have triggered on bare 'Marcus Obi.' (the SECOND caller utterance after challenge_issued) is now correctly exempted. FOLLOW-UP FIX (2026-09-15, person-window lane, PROVEN by a scratchpad probe running buildLedger/evaluate directly on both 'That's Marcus Obi.' and bare 'Marcus Obi.'): the extended window above was wired into evaluate.ts's transcript-evidence and identity-switch-resolution call sites, but NOT into the story ledger's own extractIdentityClaim call (ledger.ts) -- buildLedger computed its own, internal personQuestionAnswers with the bare 2-argument answersToPersonQuestion(conversation, actions) call, which (with no seed/claims/issued) can never resolve a challenge_issued action's field when the action carries no recorded spec (the normal corpus-fixture shape, this fixture included) and so exempted NOTHING. The bare 'Marcus Obi.' fragment was therefore still recorded by the LEDGER as a false self-identification (a CONTRADICTED identity claim), which alone bumped request_version 1->2, drove failure_tally to 1, and staled sso_pass_current/oob_confirmed_current/context_pass_current/no_contradictions -- while the cued 'That's Marcus Obi.' variant never triggered this path at all (the name doesn't open that utterance, so identity.ts's rule (b) never applies regardless of any exemption). Fix: evaluate.ts now builds the ledger in two passes -- a PROVISIONAL pass (old/narrow fallback, sound because the window only ever exempts utterances AFTER a challenge/readback action, so claims before that action are never affected) used only to reconstruct `issued` and the real extended-window exemption, then a REAL pass (`buildLedger`'s new optional personQuestionAnswers parameter) that rebuilds the actual claims/request_version with it. All three extractIdentityClaim call sites (ledger.ts, compose.ts's resolveIdentitySwitch, evidence/fromTranscript.ts) now agree on the same exemption set. Bare 'Marcus Obi.' now reaches STAGE identically to 'That's Marcus Obi.', request_version 1, failure_tally 0, every assurance item true. expected block regenerated via `npm run replay -w packages/engine -- corpus/fragment-mid-sentence-stages.json` (2026-09-15, post-person-window-lane-fix).
